columnstore.method: ALTER TABLE cpu SET (timescaledb.enable_columnstore, segmentby = 'hostname', orderby = 'ts DESC'); CALL convert_to_columnstore(chunk) for 6 chunks, 4 in parallel; VACUUM ANALYZE
